title: Site Green
text: A gallery of fossil ferns pressed into shale from the coal age, some three hundred million years old, and still alive. The fronds are green, wet and cool, and they unroll toward lamplight. A survey tag on the wall, older than anything aboard, marks the gallery SITE GREEN and forbids sampling. Nobody knows who placed it. Spores from the fronds cause coughing and a lasting smell of rain on the breath, with no other effect yet recorded. Amber runs in seams between the ferns. Some of the insects inside it are not fossils either.
teaser: The ferns are three hundred million years old and still green.
